about: Fifteen Days café test 3 (owner, 2026-10-16): six shots from the 3D set, each with its own camera render as the layout, the courtyard plate for look, the people's cards; the robot in words only.

jobs.prompt: Wide shot (WS three-shot from the west, waist-up). All three at the wide table, well apart: the tall young man with wavy shoulder-length light-brown hair and a long cream cable-knit tunic on the left (north side), the thin, wiry young woman with warm brown skin, shaved sides, a tall magenta ponytail, dangly geometric earrings, a lime-green vest and tattooed arms on the right (south side), the slim young man with spiky black hair with one blue streak, dark brown eyes and an orange cropped jacket at the far end between them, at right angles. Reference image 1 is a plain grey 3D layout render taken from this exact camera: copy its framing, height, angle and perspective, where each person sits or stands, how big each is in the frame and which way each faces, and where the table, chairs, railing, doors and walls stand; draw nothing of its grey blocks or simple figures as they are. Reference image 2 shows how the place looks: its materials, colours and light. Reference image 3 shows the three main people, one per row: the slim young man with spiky black hair with one blue streak, dark brown eyes and an orange cropped jacket; the thin, wiry young woman with warm brown skin, shaved sides, a tall magenta ponytail, dangly geometric earrings, a lime-green vest and tattooed arms; the tall young man with wavy shoulder-length light-brown hair and a long cream cable-knit tunic. Copy only their faces, hair, skin and clothes, never the sheet's layout, poses or grey background. In this frame: the tall young man is on the left of the frame, facing screen-right, in profile; the thin, wiry young woman is on the right of the frame, facing screen-left, in profile; the slim young man is in the middle of the frame, toward the camera. Exactly three main people, each appearing once. Every other person is an ordinary background figure in plain, muted everyday clothes with ordinary hair: no orange jackets, no magenta hair, no cream knitwear, nobody who looks like the main people. Behind them, as the layout shows: the wide table; a small round table for one; the street gate, dark metal bars; the low buildings on the east side, windows glowing; the megastructures and mountain pyramids above the rooftops; strings of little warm lights overhead; the quiet street beyond the gate, plain building fronts with no signs; two tea cups, a little sugar bowl and a small wall of sugar cubes on the table. The spiky-haired young man's eyes are dark brown. Detailed science fiction comic art at night: precise fine uniform linework, cel-shaded flat color, a deep blue and violet night with glowing practical lights, pools of warm and cool light on faces and surfaces, crisp silhouettes, clear readable faces and hands. Wherever the sky shows, enormous megastructures and towering buildings fill the far distance and the horizon, their lit windows and beacons glowing against the night, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance. Another time and place, not the Earth we know: unfamiliar architecture, no recognisable landmarks, vehicles or brands. Shop fronts and walls carry no lettered signs at all: at most a plain glowing panel with one single large simple pictogram (a cup, a leaf, a bowl) and nothing else. Screens show only abstract shapes. No letters, words, digits or numbers anywhere. No text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers. No cartoon murals or cartoon animals, and nothing that resembles a known character.
